message: Build an in-memory JSON counter API. Python standard library only; no runtime network assets or build step. Serve on 127.0.0.1 using python server.py --port PORT. GET /api/counter returns {"value":0} initially. POST /api/increment with {"amount":positive integer} returns 200 {"value":new value}. Reject zero, negative, boolean and noninteger amounts with 400 without changing the value. Concurrent increments are atomic: no lost increments, each response returns its own new value. Invalid or malformed JSON returns 400 with a nonempty JSON error string; unknown resource returns 404. README.md explains startup.

profile.platform: Windows, Python 3 standard library; desktop and mobile browser
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network assets, deployment or paid services.
